#Read & Prep CSVs
```{r}
# Use Sys.glob to expand wildcard paths
paths <- Sys.glob(file.path(test_path, "model_sums/*LRtest.csv")) %>% unique()

# Read all matching CSVs
output_fread <- lapply(paths, fread)
length(output_fread)
names(output_fread) <- paths
#stringr::str_extract(paths, "(?<=cv_sample_)[A-Za-z]+(?=_test)")

length(output_fread)

LR.df <- bind_rows(output_fread, .id="file") %>%
  mutate(cv_sample = stringr::str_extract(file, "(?<=cv_sample_)[A-Za-z]+(?=_test)"),
         total = stringr::str_extract(file, "(?<=total)(TRUE|FALSE)"),
         weighted  = stringr::str_detect(file, "weight"),
         age2plus = stringr::str_detect(file, "age2plus"),
         runnerup = stringr::str_detect(file, "runnerup"))%>%
  dplyr::select(!file)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#main
LR.df %>%
  group_by(cv_sample, total, weighted, age2plus) %>%
  summarise(n_phenos = n_unique(pheno))

A_totalFALSE <- LR.df %>%
  filter(cv_sample == "A" & total == "FALSE") %>%
  filter_sensitivity() %>%
  pull(pheno) %>%
  unique()
setdiff(pheno_list, A_totalFALSE)

A_totalTRUE <- LR.df %>%
  filter(cv_sample == "A" & total == "TRUE") %>%
  filter_sensitivity() %>%
  pull(pheno) %>%
  unique()
setdiff(pheno_list, A_totalTRUE)

B_totalFALSE <- LR.df %>%
  filter(cv_sample == "B" & total == "FALSE") %>%
  filter_sensitivity() %>%
  pull(pheno) %>%
  unique()
setdiff(pheno_list, B_totalFALSE)

B_totalTRUE <- LR.df %>%
  filter(cv_sample == "B" & total == "TRUE") %>%
  filter_sensitivity() %>%
  pull(pheno) %>%
  unique()
setdiff(pheno_list, B_totalTRUE)
```

Get RESI effect size

```{r}
LR.df2 <- LR.df %>%
  mutate(resi = fsq2S(fsq),
    pheno_cat = factor(case_when(
    pheno %in% vent_list ~ "Ventricular Vol",
    pheno %in% global_list ~ "Global Vol",
    pheno %in% vol_list ~ "Regional Vol",
    pheno %in% sub_list ~ "Subcortical Vol",
    pheno %in% sa_list ~ "Regional SA",
    pheno %in% ct_list ~ "Regional CT",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)))

table(LR.df2$effect, LR.df2$total)
```

```{r}
LR.df_plot <- LR.df2 %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(
    pheno %in% sub_list ~ gsub("^SUBC\\.", "", pheno),
    TRUE ~ gsub("\\.(SA|GM|CT)\\.", "_", pheno))) %>%
  mutate(label = gsub("\\.", "-", label)) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(label == "3rd-Ventricle", "x3rd-ventricle", label)) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(label == "4th-Ventricle", "x4th-ventricle", label)) %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(
    pheno == "sGMV" ~ "sGM",
    pheno == "GMV" ~ "cGM",
    pheno == "WMV" ~ "WM",
    pheno == "CSF" ~ "CSF",
    pheno == "CBV" ~ "Cerebellum",
    TRUE ~ label
  )) %>%
  group_by(total, cv_sample, age2plus, weighted, runnerup) %>% #apply FDR correction within each combo
  mutate(
    p.val_fdr = p.adjust(
      p_val,
      method = "fdr"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sig_fdr = ifelse(p.val_fdr <=0.05, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(sig_fsq = ifelse(sig_fdr==TRUE, fsq, NA),
         sig_resi = ifelse(sig_fdr==TRUE, resi, NA))

LR.df_plot$cv_sample <- factor(LR.df_plot$cv_sample, levels = c("A", "B"))
#save for review_trajectories.Rmd
saveRDS(LR.df_plot, "./data/LR_df_plot.rds")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#check cortical
setdiff(unique(dk$data$label), unique(LR.df_plot$label)) #corpus callosum is subdivided - remove from dk plots

#check subcortical
setdiff(unique(aseg$data$label), unique(LR.df_plot$label)) # all included

#check global
setdiff(unique(aseg_all$data$label), unique(LR.df_plot$tissue_class)) # all included

#see what's not included anywhere
setdiff(unique(LR.df_plot$label), c(unique(dk$data$label), unique(aseg$data$label)))
```

"Left-Accumbens-area", "Right-Accumbens-area", "Left-Cerebellum-Cortex" & "Left-Cerebellum-White-Matter" aren't in field of view for aseg atlas

#Summarise Significance

Summarise significance of all effects in main and sensitivity analyses

```{r}
all_sum <- LR.df_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(age2plus==FALSE) %>%
  group_by(total, effect, cv_sample, age2plus, weighted, runnerup) %>%
  summarise(n_sig = sum(sig_fdr==TRUE),
            n=n(),
            mean_s = mean(sig_resi, na.rm=T),
            min_s = min(sig_resi, na.rm=T),
            max_s = max(sig_resi, na.rm=T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pct_sig = (n_sig/n)*100,
         analysis = case_when(
           weighted==FALSE & age2plus == FALSE & runnerup == FALSE ~ "main",
           weighted==TRUE & age2plus == FALSE & runnerup == FALSE ~ "weighted",
           weighted==FALSE & age2plus == TRUE & runnerup == FALSE ~ "age2plus", #should have no rows
           weighted==FALSE & age2plus == FALSE & runnerup == TRUE ~ "runnerup"
         ),
         tested = case_when(
           total == FALSE & effect == "sex_age" ~ "age-by-sex",
           total == TRUE & effect=="sex_age" ~ "size-corrected age-by-sex",
           total == TRUE & effect=="sex_all" ~ "size-corrected sex effect",
         )) %>%
  select(tested, analysis, cv_sample, n_sig, n, mean_s, min_s, max_s, pct_sig)
all_sum 

#look at just CT for age2plus
ct_sum <- LR.df_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(pheno_cat=="Regional CT") %>%
  group_by(total, effect, cv_sample, age2plus, weighted, runnerup) %>%
  summarise(n_sig = sum(sig_fdr==TRUE),
            n=n(),
            mean_s = mean(sig_resi, na.rm=T),
            min_s = min(sig_resi, na.rm=T),
            max_s = max(sig_resi, na.rm=T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pct_sig = (n_sig/n)*100,
         analysis = case_when(
           weighted==FALSE & age2plus == FALSE & runnerup == FALSE ~ "main",
           weighted==TRUE & age2plus == FALSE & runnerup == FALSE ~ "weighted", #should have no rows
           weighted==FALSE & age2plus == TRUE & runnerup == FALSE ~ "age2plus",
           weighted==FALSE & age2plus == FALSE & runnerup == TRUE ~ "runnerup" #should have no rows
         ),
         tested = case_when(
           total == FALSE & effect == "sex_age" ~ "age-by-sex",
           total == TRUE & effect=="sex_age" ~ "size-corrected age-by-sex",
           total == TRUE & effect=="sex_all" ~ "size-corrected sex effect",
         )) %>%
  select(tested, analysis, cv_sample, n_sig, n, mean_s, min_s, max_s, pct_sig)
ct_sum
```

#Non-Corrected Model

```{r}
LR.df_uncor <- LR.df_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(total==FALSE) %>%
  filter_sensitivity() #remove sensitivity analysis rows

LR.df_uncor %>%
  group_by(cv_sample) %>%
  summarise(n_sig = sum(sig_fdr==TRUE),
            n=n(),
            mean_s = mean(sig_resi, na.rm=T),
            mean_fsq = mean(sig_fsq, na.rm=T)) %>%
  mutate(pct_sig = (n_sig/n)*100)

ggplot(LR.df_uncor) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x=sig_resi, fill=pheno_cat), position='identity', alpha=0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~cv_sample)

range(LR.df_uncor$sig_fsq, na.rm=T)
range(LR.df_uncor$sig_resi, na.rm=T)
```

```{r}
#removing ventricles for visualization:
LR.df_uncor_novent <- LR.df_uncor %>%
  filter(!(pheno %in% vent_list))
range(LR.df_uncor_novent$resi)
full_plt_uncor <- plot_cv_brain(df = LR.df_uncor_novent, 
                          fill_var = resi, 
                          fill_name = "S", 
                          fill_color =  "grDevices::Greens 2", 
                          fill_limits =  c(0,0.1),
                          facet_var= "cv_sample",
                          height_list=c(1.03, 4.5, .93), 
                          return_plt = TRUE, 
                          include_global = TRUE, 
                          rel_widths = c(3, .6),
                          direction = -1,
                          fill_values = NULL)

ggsave("figs/supplement/resi_uncorrected.png", full_plt_uncor, dpi=600, height=8.5, width=7.1, bg = "white")
```


####CT in ages 2+
Sensitivity analyses

```{r}
#find phenos where both full and age2plus are significant
LR.df_agree <- LR.df_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(total == FALSE) %>%
  filter_sensitivity(sens = setdiff(sensitivity_cols, "age2plus")) %>%
  group_by(cv_sample, pheno) %>%
  filter(
    all(sig_fdr == TRUE) &        # all rows must be sig
    n_distinct(age2plus) == 2     # both levels of age2plus must be present
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

LR.df_agree %>%
  group_by(cv_sample) %>%
  summarise(n=n()/2)
```

similar but slightly larger S, slightly fewer significant regions

##Save Table
save out csv with all significance tests

```{r}
LR_table <- LR.df_plot %>%
  select(total, effect, weighted, age2plus, runnerup, pheno_cat, pheno, cv_sample, chi, df, p_val, fsq, resi, p.val_fdr, sig_fdr) %>%
  rename(total_size_covar = total,
         effect_tested = effect,
         surfhole_weighted = weighted,
         idp_category = pheno_cat,
         idp = pheno,
         p.val = p_val,
         significant_fdr = sig_fdr) %>%
  mutate(effect_tested = ifelse(effect_tested=="sex_age", "age-varying sex component", "any sex effect"))

fwrite(LR_table, "figs/supplement/significance_test_results.csv")
```
